Review of assign_rooms (request_changes): The test_regression_issue_667 has incorrect expected output. With meetings sorted by (start, end, id), 'plan' comes before 'sync' alphabetically. Rooms sorted by (capacity, name): Atlas(5) before Borea(8). So 'plan'(needs 5) gets Atlas first, then 'sync'(needs 4) gets Borea. Expected should be {"plan": "Atlas", "sync": "Borea"} as in test_same_start_time, not {"sync": "Atlas", "plan": "Borea"}. Please fix the test_regression_issue_667 expected value.

This looks like a bug. Please remove the weekend check or update the specification/docstring if skipping weekends is intended.
